parameters.claim: H092 (P4-27): a BUB1B loss-of-function expression signature is reversed by at least one approved drug in two independent connectivity engines, and specifically to that signature
parameters.mechanism_note: loss-of-function query: stop_gained + destabilising missense (entries 083, 149); hypomorph phenotype twin (entry 150)
parameters.patient_data: none. Public LINCS signatures, gene symbols and drug names only. This experiment uses the genomic source (the mechanism class of the child's alleles) to choose the query; it reads no clinical (HPO) term.

test: H092 (P4-27): a BUB1B loss-of-function expression signature is reversed by at least one approved drug in two independent connectivity engines, and specifically to that signature. Signature: top 100 raised and lowered landmark genes of the BUB1B consensus, BUB1B itself excluded. Compound rank = rank of its best reverser signature (SigCom z-sum; iLINCS concordance). Decoys: 20 random 100+100 draws from the same space, seed 20260925, through SigCom l1000_cp. Positive control: BUB1, BUB3, MAD1L1, MAD2L1, TTK gene-level mimicker rank in l1000_xpr, l1000_shRNA, pass at <= 5% of genes.
